ui.welcome.title: Welcome
ui.welcome.lead: Your passwords are encrypted on this device. Only ciphertext is stored at the storage location.
ui.welcome.join_sub: Use a vault created on another device on this one too (requires your Emergency Kit)
ui.storage.drive_note: Sign in to Google in your browser. The app only touches files it created.
ui.storage.folder_note: Save to a folder such as Google Drive for desktop.
ui.storage.oauth_missing: This build does not include Google sign-in settings. Choose a synced folder, or put oauth-client.json in the settings folder.
ui.create.title: Create a new vault
ui.create.hint: A long passphrase of 4–5 words is recommended.
ui.create.note: Creating a vault generates a Secret Key (a 128-bit random value) on this device. Your password and Secret Key are never sent to the author of 2password or to Google.
ui.strength.label: Strength: {level} ({score}/4)
ui.busy.google: Sign in to Google in your browser…
ui.created.title: Your vault is ready
ui.created.lead_html:
You need this Secret Key to use 2password on a new device.
Print your Emergency Kit and keep it somewhere locked.
ui.created.open_kit: Open and print the Emergency Kit
ui.created.kit_done: I printed it and stored it safely (delete the Kit file after printing)
ui.join.title: Join an existing vault
ui.lock.auto: Locked automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity
ui.lock.browser: Locked because the browser extension sent many requests in a short time. If you don't recognize this, check your extensions
ui.main.empty: Choose an item from the list, or register one with “+ Add”.
ui.copy.done: Copied (cleared from the clipboard in {sec} seconds)
ui.totp.remove_body: This removes the two-step verification setup for “{title}” from 2password. Two-step verification stays on at the site, so you won't be able to sign in without another authenticator app or recovery codes.
ui.passkey.remove_body: This deletes the passkey for “{title}” from 2password. It stays registered at the site, so remove it in the site's settings too.
ui.delete.title: Delete this item?
ui.delete.body: “{title}” will be deleted. This also applies to your other devices.
ui.edit.title: Title
ui.edit.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current one
ui.edit.totp_empty: Leave empty if you don't have one
ui.edit.totp_set: Already set (enter only to change it)
ui.edit.totp_help_html: In the site's two-step verification settings, paste the letters and numbers shown near the QR code (look for “Can't scan the QR code?” or “setup key”). A URL starting with otpauth:// also works.
ui.edit.url_help_html: Browser autofill only works on pages with the same host name as written here. To use it on subdomains too, write *.example.com.
ui.edit.totp_failed: The item was saved, but the one-time password could not be set: {error}
ui.approve.password: Use your password on this site?
ui.approve.passkey: Use your passkey on this site?
ui.approve.lead: The browser extension is asking to sign in to the following site. This is the first time this item is used here.
ui.approve.question: Did you just open this site in your browser to sign in? If not, click “Deny”.
ui.approve.allowed: Allowed. Choose the item again in your browser
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.storage_note: All Google Drive can see is file names, sizes, modification times, and meaningless ciphertext.
ui.settings.migrate: Move from synced folder to Google Drive
ui.settings.passwd_note: The vault itself is not re-encrypted; only the Vault Key is re-wrapped. Your other devices will use the new password from their next unlock.
ui.settings.browser_note: With the Chrome / Edge / Brave extension, 2password can fill in sign-in pages and save logins after you sign in. After installing the extension, connect it here.
ui.settings.browser_extid: Specify an extension ID (if you built the extension yourself)
ui.settings.browser_guard: The first time an item is used on a site, you confirm it in this app. If many requests arrive in a short time, the app locks automatically. Unencrypted pages (http) are never filled.
ui.settings.browser_log: Requests from the extension (cleared when locked)
ui.settings.browser_not_connected: Not connected (connect again after updating or moving the app)
ui.settings.browser_connected_toast: Connected: {browsers} (restart the browser to be sure)
ui.settings.forget_body: The next time you use an item in the browser, you'll be asked again for each site.
ui.settings.import_note: Imports a CSV exported from 1Password, Chrome, Edge, Bitwarden, and others. After importing, delete the CSV file (it contains plain-text passwords).
ui.settings.import_too_big: The file is too large (up to 20 MB)
ui.settings.import_done: Imported {added} items (skipped {skipped} duplicates). Delete the CSV file
ui.settings.device_note: Locks automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity. Copied passwords are cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds.
ui.settings.device_forget_note: Deletes this device's settings and Secret Key. The ciphertext at the storage location remains, and you can join again with your Emergency Kit.
ui.settings.device_forget_body: This deletes this device's settings and Secret Key. The ciphertext at the storage location remains. To use it again, you'll need the Secret Key from your Emergency Kit.
ui.google.login_prompt: Sign in to Google in your browser
ui.google.logout_body: This revokes the Google token on this device. You'll need to sign in again the next time you sync.
ui.migrate.title: Move to Google Drive
ui.migrate.body: Moves the vault, still encrypted, to Google Drive (the 2password-vault folder). Your password and Secret Key don't change.
ui.kit.password: Account password (don't write it here; keep it somewhere else)
ui.kit.warn1: Print this page and keep it somewhere locked.
ui.kit.warn2: On a new device, choose “Join an existing vault” in the 2password app, then enter this Secret Key and your account password.
ui.kit.warn3: If you lose both your Secret Key and your account password, no one can recover your vault.
